item.title: Watch Out for Fake Delivery Texts This Holiday Season
item.dc:creator: Sample Author
item.description: Scammers are sending fake USPS delivery texts that claim a package is on hold until a small redelivery fee is paid.
item.content:encoded:
Scammers are sending fake USPS delivery texts that claim a package is on hold until a small redelivery fee is paid.

The link leads to a page that collects card details.

Don’t click on links in unsolicited texts. Check the status of a package directly on the carrier’s website.
